mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_messages (id, session_id, role, content, created_at) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{sessionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{role}, #{content}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_messages m JOIN qa_sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.role = 'user'

SELECT m.content FROM qa_messages m JOIN qa_sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.role = 'user' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
